summary: Replaced greedy slot picking with exact global assignment search, explicit civil-time fold/gap resolution, dependency enforcement, room-block exclusion, and directed setup checks on consecutive person meetings. Added deterministic regression and exhaustive-oracle tests.
tests_run: functions.tests: public.test.mjs and candidate.test.mjs; 10 tests passed, 0 failed
Candidate randomized differential validation: 60 deterministic six-meeting UTC cases compared against exhaustive assignment enumeration
limitations: Assumes well-formed inputs and the stated bounds; does not add input validation.
Timezone resolution targets the five contracted zones in 2024–2026 and depends on the installed Node Intl timezone database.
Exact search is exponential in the worst case; pruning reduces search but does not provide a polynomial-time guarantee.
No live calendar, network, external packages, or external test suites were accessed.
